crossRefs.note: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.

translations.web: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.
translations.bsb: You must not lend him your silver at interest or sell him your food for profit.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.
translations.asv: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon interest, nor give him thy victuals for increase.
